citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care (dealers and exhibitors).
citations.narrative:
The attending veterinarian’s site visits have not been performed at the frequency written in the Program of Veterinary
Care. The current Program of Veterinary Care states the attending veterinarian will have regularly scheduled visits semi-
annually. The last site visit by the attending veterinarian, per the licensee has not occurred over the last few years.
Regularly scheduled visits by the veterinarian help to ensure the health and welfare of the animals. It is a time that allows
the veterinarian to provide guidance in the care and use
of animals regarding husbandry, handling, pest control, and product use etc.
Each dealer and exhibitor shall employ an attending veterinarian under formal arrangements. In the case of a part-time
attending veterinarian or consultant arrangements, the formal arrangements shall include a written program of veterinary
care and regularly scheduled visits to the premises of the dealer or exhibitor.
Correct from this day forward.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
